offlineOcr.network: HTTP(S), fetch, TCP and TLS blocked in main and worker processes; no API key

checks: System-default language, live English and Chinese, and dedicated shortcuts for all actions
One model per provider, duplicate credentials and settings, and bidirectional feature assignments
Real text, detection and image HTTP requests use each provider's model, scoped key, headers and temperature
Fetched models replace presets; mouse and keyboard selections stay non-custom, and manual mode restores the previous selection
Model search and discovery, export-safe credentials, and language persistence
providerSettings.scope: Isolated Electron profile, real renderer and loopback Chat Completions fixture

checks: missing selection shows an explicit capture route; no implicit screenshot or model request
Esc and right-click cancel the real capture overlay, restore draft and pin, and never start OCR
local OCR starts once without a text model; corrected text reuses action cards, preserves its image, and never offers replacement
remote OCR displays its destination and sends one image only after the recognition click
switching OCR providers recognizes the current image immediately, including while busy; late results from the previous provider cannot replace the new result
OCR cancellation/new images isolate late results; text actions stay disabled while recognizing
an empty real OCR result offers recapture and cannot trigger a text action
The actual selection preview is pixel-identical to the native screenshot at current DPI; taskbar sizing and click-without-drag are correct
actual desktop capture matches the pointer-selected pixels at current scaling and automatically completes local OCR
screenshotAndOcr.scope: Real Electron windows, desktop capture/crop pixel comparison, and bundled Tesseract. Imported images use development hooks; remote OCR and text use a local HTTP fixture. Controlled foreground content, native UIA selection and external model quality are not implied by these checks.

checks: System preview used the selected Windows voice and prosody, emitted start and end, and made zero network requests
Online preview and autosave used the selected speech provider and custom voice; Chromium decoded audio and applied pitch, speed and volume
Fallback preview plays the selected Chinese system voice while English is mapped online
Stop aborts an in-flight speech request before audio arrives
Selection toolbar detects English locally and plays the actual selected text using its online mapping
The translation result uses its target language with the saved voice and keeps the speech model separate from the text model
Starting a system preview stops the online request in a different pinned result window
The assigned provider's connection test uses the audio endpoint; there were no renderer errors
Removing a custom voice clears only its assignments
MiMo provider automatically routes TTS, shows only speech features, hides irrelevant advanced toggles and tests the real speech endpoint
MiMo voice choices are separate from OpenAI; Chromium plays decoded MiMo audio and voice/style settings survive reload
All 34 provider choices have working offline icons and no horizontal overflow in both themes
Every preset adds and autosaves the upstream default model; no network request on add
The selected ID remains visible; reopening scrolls to it; custom/builtin switching survives restart
Discovery replaces built-in choices with all 121 remote models; selecting one turns custom input off
Discovery errors and empty responses preserve the current model and allow retry
Custom endpoints accept an explicit ID and allow switching to a discovered model
providerCatalog.scope: Isolated Electron windows and local HTTP fixtures; no real provider credentials or external model calls.

checks: Native Gemini streaming connection test uses the configured desktop proxy
Desktop OCR reaches native Gemini with image data and the same proxy
Selection translation works without a model; switching between native and pure providers updates the result and reuses cache
nativeProviderAndProxy.scope: Isolated Electron profile, local HTTP origin and proxy; no paid provider credentials.

checks: Automatic updates default on, save immediately, and stay separate from portable configuration
Update preference survives an application restart
About shows the brand, version, source, feedback and licenses; only fixed project links can open
Updates share the About page; download routes switch internally and never appear in the update card
Current, download progress, proxy fallback, ready, and error views have the correct controls
Chinese and English, both themes, and a compact window preserve readable navigation
Floating panels cannot install updates or change update preferences
aboutAndUpdates.scope: Real settings windows and persistence. Update presentation states use development-only hooks; manifest, transport, hashes, and updater coordination are covered by separate tests. No installer is executed by this UI test.

liveProvider.scope: Isolated profile copy using the configured provider and synthetic text/image samples. No credentials, generated content or personal notes are recorded. MiMo/OpenAI speech use local protocol fixtures, not live cloud credentials.

limitations: Cloud translation, structured dictionary and image OCR were tested with the configured provider and synthetic samples. Provider credentials and generated content are not recorded.
OpenAI and MiMo speech protocols were tested with local HTTP fixtures and actual Chromium audio decoding/playback. This is not a live MiMo cloud account test.
macOS and Linux native desktop interactions were not exercised on this Windows machine. GitHub Actions separately validates platform builds and packages before publication.
